$comment: Read read-only from production via `wp site list --fields=blog_id,url,domain,path` on extrachill.com, 2026-09-23. Blog IDs are NOT reproduced in the disposable rig: WordPress assigns new sequential blog IDs to wp_insert_site() in a fresh install, so every part of this rig matches sites by domain, never by blog ID. `install` is subdomain per wp-config.php SUBDOMAIN_INSTALL=true; extrachill.link is a distinct core multisite domain (not a sunrise.php path-mapping target) matching how sunrise.php actually behaves in production (see NETWORK-ARCHITECTURE.MD spike notes on extrachill-network#223).

sites.title: Extra Chill Link Pages
sites.expectedHomepageStatusNote: extrachill-artist-platform renders extrachill.link's homepage through its link-page routing, which requires a provisioned link page (an artist claiming the root slug) to return 200 -- exactly like production 404s an unclaimed slug. A brand-new disposable site with no seeded link-page content 404s on '/' by design, not by rig defect; verified live via `homeboy rig up` on 2026-09-23.
